description: Make a new look recipe in the workspace's library (version 1) and queue its looping cover GIF. It starts from the defaults, a copy of another recipe (from_recipe_id), or the look read out of a post's video edit (from_post_id: grade, caption and title styles, animations, transitions, pacing, sound rules, music); look then sets any settings on top as a partial recipe, for example {"grade":{"look":{"warmth":0.2}},"captions":{"style":"bold","motion":"word_pop"}}. Every value is clamped to its range; notes says what changed. A recipe made by an assistant is marked as agent-made and changes no video until a person or an account uses it. Call recipe_schema first: it lists every setting with its path, limits, choices and whether the phone draws it yet.

description.description: One line in the person's words about what the look is for

family.description: A format family id (see formats_list) or any

from_post_id.description: Read the look out of this post's current video edit

from_recipe_id.description: Start from a copy of this recipe (a workspace recipe or house:<id>)

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

look.description: A partial recipe: only the settings to set

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: recipe_create
title: Create a recipe
